subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the read tool get a narrow binary-document fallback now, or should this issue wait for broader document extraction/provider-native file work?
rationale: Current source still has the token-waste behavior, but the issue's alternatives span a small safety fallback and larger document parsing/provider contracts that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Land Narrow Fallback
options.body: Review or replace the linked guard PR so known PDF/Office reads return a clear unsupported-document message while normal text and image reads keep working.

options.title: Fold Into Document Work
options.body: Keep this issue as context for broader document extraction or provider-native file architecture and close the conflicting guard PR.

options.title: Reject Core Fallback
options.body: Leave read as text/image-only and document that Office/PDF handling belongs in a plugin, MCP tool, or explicit document extractor.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Fallback
recommendation.body: Review or replace the linked guard PR so known PDF/Office reads return a clear unsupported-document message while normal text and image reads keep working.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent read-tool/runtime history signal and are the best available owner for choosing the read-tool contract.
